Jul 15 at 11:00 PDT works for me. A couple of quick asks so we can make the session actionable:

1) Please share the following before EOD Tue Jul 13 if possible:
   - Peak concurrent requests (p95 and absolute peak)
   - Average and max sequence lengths (tokens)
   - Target latency SLOs (p50/p95) and acceptable tail limits
   - Any tenant isolation constraints (per-tenant billing separation, encryption/KMS, network segmentation)

2) For pool-sizing we typically use this rough calc to produce an initial reserve:
   - baseline_gpus = ceil((peak_concurrency * avg_token_per_request) / tokens_per_gpu_per_sec)
   - tokens_per_gpu_per_sec depends on model family and quantization; we'll ask for model name if known

3) If you expect steady background traffic plus frequent spikes, we should discuss a hybrid: reserved pool + burstable capacity with prewarmed standby replicas to reduce scale-up latency.

I'll prepare two sizing scenarios (conservative and aggressive) given the numbers you provide. Dylan will cover autoscaling knobs and our recommended fallback policies.

See you on Jul 15 if that works.

-Marcus
